Class H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper
public final class H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper extends Object
Stateless analytical physics, Lotka stable demography, surface geometry, Garrett-Lotka a posteriori diagnostic evaluation, and Data-Oriented Design (DOD) component helper for H3Cell.

Strictly enforces AGENTS.md Section 10: all equations are \(C^\infty\) smooth functions of conserved primary biophysical observables with zero state-level technology dependence.

1.0.0-beta.3

  • Method Details

    • computeGarrettLotkaEmergentIndex

      public static double computeGarrettLotkaEmergentIndex(double totalPowerWattsPerIndividual, double grossCapitalPerIndividual, double basalMetabolicWatts)
      Evaluates the canonical \(C^\infty\) Garrett-Lotka emergent exergy-capital diagnostic \(T_{\text{emergent}}\) strictly a posteriori from conserved power flux and physical capital stock:

      $$\mathcal{M} = \frac{p_{\text{eff}}}{B_{\text{basal}}}, \qquad k_{\text{energized}} = \frac{\operatorname{softplus}(p_{\text{eff}}; 0.8 B_{\text{basal}}, 0.2 B_{\text{basal}})}{\lambda_{\text{maint}}}, \qquad k_{\text{active}} = \frac{2 \cdot k \cdot k_{\text{energized}}}{k + k_{\text{energized}} + \varepsilon}$$

      $$T_{\text{emergent}}(\mathcal{M}, k_{\text{active}}) = 0.50 + 1.45 \log_{10}(\mathcal{M}) + 0.58 \log_{10}\!\left(1 + \frac{k_{\text{active}}}{k_0}\right)$$

      Resolves the post-collapse depopulation paradox (\(N \to 0 \implies K/N \to \infty\)): if power plants cease operating (\(p \to B_{\text{basal}}\)), \(k_{\text{energized}}\) remains bounded at somatic maintenance capacity, preventing unphysical blow-up of \(k_{\text{active}}\).

      Parameters:
      totalPowerWattsPerIndividual - somatic + exosomatic power captured per individual (\(\text{W}\))
      grossCapitalPerIndividual - gross structural capital stock per individual (\(K/N\))
      basalMetabolicWatts - Kleiber basal metabolic rate \(B_{\text{basal}}(M_b)\) (\(\text{W}\))
      Returns:
      dimensionless emergent telemetry diagnostic bounded smoothly in \([0.0, 10.0]\)

      public static double computeEmergentTechnologyDiagnostic(H3Cell cell)

      Returns:

    • calculateMovementFriction

      public static double calculateMovementFriction(H3Cell cell)
      Calculates \(C^\infty\) continuous terrain movement friction (cost-distance multiplier) based on topographic relief (Minetti et al. 2002), standing vegetation impedance, cryospheric snow resistance, and physical transport infrastructure capital density: $$f_{\text{move}} = \operatorname{sclamp}\!\left((f_{\text{relief}} + f_{\text{veg}} + f_{\text{snow}}) \cdot f_{\text{infra}},\; 0.30,\; 25.0\right)$$
      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
      Returns:
      updated movement friction multiplier (\(1.0\) = flat plain, \(>10.0\) = rugged/glaciated)

    • calculateDynamicAlbedo

      public static double calculateDynamicAlbedo(H3Cell cell)
      Calculates \(C^\infty\) dynamic surface albedo \(\alpha \in [0.06, 0.85]\) using the Sellers (1969) / Dickinson et al. (1993, BATS) thermodynamic surface energy balance model: $$\alpha = (1 - f_{\text{snow}}) [f_{\text{veg}} \alpha_{\text{veg}} + (1 - f_{\text{veg}}) \alpha_{\text{soil}}] + f_{\text{snow}} \alpha_{\text{snow}}$$
      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
      Returns:
      updated surface albedo \(\alpha\)

    • updateAgePyramidFromObservables

      public static void updateAgePyramidFromObservables(H3Cell cell)
      Updates the detailed 7-segment Lotka (1907) stable age pyramid from total population, life expectancy \(e_0\) (lifespan), and total fertility rate (fertility).

      Replaces legacy technology-indexed interpolation with authentic demographic transition coordinates: longevity survival index \(\ell = \sigma(e_0; 52, 12)\) and fertility moderation index \(f = \sigma(4.2 - \text{TFR}; 0, 1.1)\).

      Parameters:
      cell - target H3 cell
